caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped tin box with a yellow background. The surface of the box is decorated with illustrations of a rural scene. On the side of the box, there is a prominent windmill in the center with four blades, and the words "RAIL ROAD" are printed in uppercase letters beside it. On either side of the windmill, there are two houses with brown thatched roofs. There are several large leafy green trees around the houses and windmill. At the base of the box, there is a railcar drawn by a horse, with stacked barrels or cargo visible in the railcar. The colors used are mainly shades of yellow, brown, green, and muted red. The top of the box, though mostly dark in color, appears to continue the rural and building theme, with faint shapes suggestive of buildings and landscape elements. The composition is bordered with a decorative band at the top and bottom.
title: Bandbox
